description: A picture of the game: the whole screen, one region or node of it at full resolution, or one viewport. The screen is the game's window with its dialogs and popups over it. Needs a running game with a window. A capture before its first frame waits for it. Operations: screenshot: the screen; viewport: one viewport's texture. Default screenshot.

height.description: Scale to this height. Width follows unless given.

inline.description: Send the picture back in the answer. Default true, as a JPEG when smaller than the PNG and nothing is transparent. false needs outputPath.

nodePath.description: Capture only where this node is drawn. Not with region. For op screenshot.

outputPath.description: Also save a PNG here. Absolute path outside the project, to a file that does not exist.

region.description: Capture only this rectangle: x, y, width and height in window pixels, as runtime_inspect rect answers. For op screenshot.

viewportPath.description: The Viewport node. Default the root viewport. A hidden or minimised Window is refused. For op viewport.

width.description: Scale to this width. Height follows unless given.

zoom.description: Enlarge the picture this many times. Not with width or height. Default 1.

name: runtime_capture
title: Capture the screen
